Author: PlatyDuckbill
Name: DuckbillTweak
Description:
Small conveniences in the game's own UI, for FFXIV Korea.

• Filter owned equipment and collectibles, or focus shop lists on collection items.
• Calculate the current shop's currency requirements and shortages, with linked storage records.
• Right-click loot items to view participant choices and publicly received roll results.
• Enable PvP chat bubbles using your game's chat bubble settings.
• Mark positional hits/misses and broken combos on your own damage numbers with game icons and colors.
• Right-click a character in a looping emote to perform the same emote in time with them.

Open settings: /dbtw or /duckbilltweak. Each feature starts disabled.
Release history: Settings → 업데이트 내역, or /dbtw changelog.

Korean client and Dalamud API 15 only. Loot numbers appear when the game publishes results. Stored inventory records may be incomplete or out of date.
Punchline: Shop collection filters, currency planning and loot results for FFXIV Korea.
Changelog:
• PvP chat bubbles, currency exchange shop tools and positional/combo markers work again after the 2026.11.03 game update.
• These features no longer stop on every game update. Only a feature whose game code cannot be found turns off, with a notice in settings.
• Release history now shows every version on one scrolling page.

Author: PlatyDuckbill
Name: DuckbillFisher
Description:
Let Duckbill guide your next catch.
A big-fish hunting companion for FFXIV: choose your next target, prepare baits, and track your collection.

• Choose your next big fish by availability, mooch chains and Intuition requirements.
• Plan spawns with a timeline and monthly calendar, including Fish Eyes and Intuition forecasts.
• Track collection progress by expansion and region, synced with the in-game Fish Guide.
• Prepare baits for favorites or filtered fish, with inventory counts and in-game bait highlights.
• Get local alerts for favorites and uncaught big fish at your current fishing hole, with optional sounds.
• Follow casts with a timer and personal fishing records.
• Browse fish with filters, baits, conditions and map links; see fish available now in the quick list.

Open: /dbfs or /duckbillfisher. /dbfs cl: compact list; /dbfs ct: casting timer.
UI: English / Korean. Game names follow your client.

Does not automate fishing or send anything to the server.
The plugin icon was created with AI assistance.
Punchline: Let Duckbill guide your next catch.
Changelog:
• Use the new Ocean Fishing Beta tab to check departures, your current route, area time remaining and basic baits.
• Narrow Ocean Fishing lists by time, weather and Intuition conditions while keeping unconfirmed fish visible.
• See minimum Gathering requirements in fish details where data is available.
• Check collectable delivery targets and collectability tiers in fish details.
• Find Double Hook and Triple Hook yield guidance for more fish.
• Choose Graphite or Paper in settings to change the plugin's appearance.
• Browse fish at each fishing hole in the in-game Fishing Log order.

Author: PlatyDuckbill
Name: DuckbillCalendar
Description:
한국 파이널판타지14의 주요 일정과 나의 약속을 한 달력에서 확인합니다.

• 주요 이벤트·업데이트·게임 서버 점검과 공식 안내 링크
• 하우징 청약 신청·결과 확인·구매 확정 기간
• 일정 이름·버전 검색과 해당 날짜로 이동
• 개인·공격대 일정, 요일별 시각을 지정하는 여러 주 일괄 등록
• 이용권 만료일과 일·시간·분 단위 충전 관리
• 사용자 분류·아이콘·색상과 미드나이트·차콜·라이트 테마
• 오늘·내일 전장 정보와 선택형 알림

열기: /dbcal 또는 /duckbillcalendar
업데이트 내역: 설정 → 업데이트 내역 또는 /dbcal changelog

한국어 전용, Dalamud API 15. 개인 일정·이용권은 로컬에 저장합니다. 알림은 기본 꺼짐이며 설정에서 켤 수 있습니다.
대표 아이콘은 AI 이미지 도구를 사용해 제작했습니다.
Punchline: 한국 서비스 일정과 개인 이용권을 한 달력에.
Changelog:
하우징 청약과 달력 검색
• 하우징 신청·결과 확인·구매 확정 기간과 오늘·내일 마감 표시
• 검색 버튼/Ctrl+F로 일정 이름·버전을 찾고 해당 날짜로 이동
• 새소식 탭을 달력 검색으로 통합하고 숨긴 일정도 설정 변경 없이 확인
• 선택 날짜 강조, 주말 구분, 상단 도구 고정과 설정 화면 개선
• 일정 제목 한 줄 표시와 하우징 설명 줄바꿈 개선

하우징은 에테르웨이 한국 서버 주기 기준이며 게임 내 표시와 공식 공지를 우선 확인하세요.
전체 내역: 설정 → 업데이트 내역 또는 /dbcal changelog
